plugins.description: DSH plugin: lists the files a conversation turn produced or changed as plain text, and reveals a file in the OS file manager on double-click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-GotoFile > 对话结尾列出本轮**产出 / 修改**的文件，**双击路径**直接在资源管理器里定位。 > A DSH plugin that prints the files a turn produced or changed — **double-click a path to reveal it in your OS file manager.** DSH 的官方「改动文件」卡片只活在浏览器里：要离开 GUI 读一份清单、要整段复制路径、要在资源管理器里打开文件，都得再手动翻一遍。这个插件把同一份「本轮改动」数据渲染成**纯文本行**放进对话结尾，并让每一行路径都能双击落到系统文件管理器。 ``` 本轮产出 / 修改 3 个文件（双击路径在文件管理器中定位） [复制全部] ● 新 report.md — E:\workspace\project\docs\report.md 📂 ● 改 index.js — E:\workspace\project\src\index.js 📂 ● 改 old-config.yml — E:\workspace\project\old-config.yml （已不存在） ``` 真实运行效果（结尾的文本块：「已编辑 3 个文件」卡片是 DSH 自带的，下面一行才是本插件）： ![turn-tail 文本报告](assets/screenshot-turn-tail.png) ## 特性 - **文本，不是卡片**：整段可选中、可复制（右上角「复制全部」一键拷走全部绝对路径），粘贴到哪里都好用。 - **双击即定位**：双击路径文本 → Windows 资源管理器（`explorer /select,`）与 macOS Finder（`open -R`）会打开并**选中**该文件；Linux 没有统一的「在文件管理器中选中」接口，`xdg-open` 只能**打开文件本身**（目录则打开该目录）。 - **正文里的路径也能双击**：`` `src/index.js` `` 这种裸路径、或手动选中的一段路径，双击同样生效——不用回到报告里找。 - **只记真的写成功的**：登记 `write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor` / `ops_replace` 的**成功**调用，失败的、只读的调用一律不出现。 - **新 / 改 有区分**：本轮首次写入该路径 = **新**；改动一个已存在的文件 = **改**。 - **失效文件自动置灰**：文件被外部删掉的行显示「（已不存在）」并禁用双击。 - **零依赖、无构建**：两个源文件（宿主半 + 浏览器半），`node --test` 直接跑单测。 - **默认就安全**：所有路由先过本机同源校验（Origin 的端口必须与请求 Host 的端口一致，本地别的开发端口一律拒绝），请求体只收 `application/json`；只有会话工作目录 / 家目录（凭据类目录除外）/ 用户显式声明的白名单根里的路径才能被系统打开。 ## 安装 已发布到 npm：****（包名只能小写，仓库与插件显示名仍写作 *dsh-GotoFile*）。 **方式一：官方 CLI（推荐）** ```bash # 先退出桌面端客户端：desktop profile 在桌面端运行时被独占，plugin 命令会被拒绝 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-gotofile ``` **方式二：手动装进 profile** ```bash cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop" # Windows 下类似 E:\...\2-DSH运行数据\profiles\desktop pnpm add dsh-gotofile # 或 npm i dsh-gotofile ``` 装完 `package.json` 里应该有 `"dsh-gotofile": "^1.0.4"`（`dependencies`）与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的一项 —— 后者是它出现在**插件管理**列表里的前提（只把目录塞进 `node_modules` 而不写依赖，宿主侧能挂载，但插件管理里看不到它）。 然后在同一个 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾登记（DSH 的插件市场/插件管理安装时也会自动写入这一行）： ```yaml - insert: - id: goto-file name: dsh-gotofile ``` 手动安装也行——把整包放进 profile 的 `node_modules`： ``` /node_modules/dsh-gotofile/ /cordis.patch.yml ``` 改完 `cordis.patch.yml` 需要**重启桌面端**（或重新加载 profile）才会挂载。挂载成功可以在插件管理里看到 `goto-file` / `dsh-gotofile` / 状态 `active`。 ## 配置：外置盘 / 网络盘白名单 `设置 → GotoFile`，每行一个根目录（支持 `~/` 与 `~\`），**保存立即生效**，不用重启、不用改 YAML。 - 默认留空 = 只放行**会话工作目录**与**家目录**内的路径；其他位置的路径双击会被拒绝，报告里仍会列出但打开请求返回 404。 - 盘根可以直接填：`D:\`、`F:\` 都行（也接受只写 `D:`，会补成盘根；带不带尾斜杠、盘符大小写都不影响）。 - 家目录里有一批**凭据类目录默认不放行**（`AppData`、`Library`、`.ssh`、`.aws`、`.gnupg`、`.kube`、`.docker`、`.npmrc`、`.netrc`、`.git-credentials`）——这些位置的文件一旦被系统默认程序打开，等于把本机账号交出去。确实需要时把它们写进白名单即可（写进去 = 显式授权）。 - 系统盘特征目录（`C:\` 之类，即根下存在 `Windows` / `System` / `etc`）会被自动拒绝，避免一条白名单把整台机器敞开口。 - 白名单根还会做 `realpath` 逃逸检查（symlink 不能溜出根）。 ## 权限：它会碰什么 - **会话**：只监听 `session/event` 里的 `tool/call` 与 `tool/result`，读取工具名和路径参数并配对；不读对话正文，不改会话数据，不落盘。 - **文件**：只对报告里的路径做存在性检查（`existsSync` / `statSync`）；「打开」交给系统文件管理器（Windows `explorer`、macOS `open -R`、Linux `xdg-open`），经 `execFile` 直传参数、不经 shell，不会执行文件内容。 - **路径范围**：会话工作目录、家目录（`AppData` / `.ssh` / `.npmrc` 等凭据类目录默认拒绝）、你显式声明的白名单根。 - **网络**：**不联网**。没有遥测、没有外部请求；三条路由只服务本机，且校验同源与端口。 *What it touches: session tool events (names + path arguments only, message text is not read), file existence checks, the OS file manager for reveal/open, and no network at all.* ## 工作原理（一图） ``` 一轮对话 │ 工具调用 write / edit / str_replace_editor / ops_replace ▼ 宿主半 lib/index.js ctx.on('session/event') tool/call ──► pending.set(callId, {turn, 路径, 是否新建}) tool/result ──► 只有成功（isError !== true）才计入登记簿 ├ op = 新建且首次收录 ? 'new' : 'edit' └ 子代理会话（origin==='subagent'）不参与 (可选补漏) ctx.get('workspaceChanges').summary(...) → 官方含 git 快照的权威清单 POST /api/goto-file/check → 本轮文件清单 POST /api/goto-file/open → 系统打开 / 定位（同源校验 + 路径安全口径） ▼ 浏览器半 lib/client.js turnTail 槽：渲染纯文本行，双击判 event.detail === 2 → /open reveal 正文双击委托：document dblclick 抓裸 / 选中文本 → /open reveal ``` 源码级查证过的坑（八条，含 `explorer.exe` 把 `/` 当开关、turnTail 槽在 0.1.7 前后的双模签名、`webServer` 必须动态注入等）都记在 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。 ## 源码结构 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：本轮改动登记簿 + 三条 API 路由 + 路径安全判定 + 系统打开 | | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：turn-tail 文本报告、双击委托、设置卡片 | | `test/` | 单测：`host.test.js`（宿主半纯逻辑）+ `manifest.test.js`（包清单一致性），共 30 例，`node --test` | | `docs/architecture.md` | 架构、数据流与关键决策 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 供参考的挂载补丁片段 | ## 开发 ```bash node --test # 30 个单测，零依赖、无需 npm install ``` 宿主半对 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 的依赖是**懒加载**的（挂载时才解析真包，解析不到就退回恒等形态）， 所以这个仓库可以被单独克隆出来直接跑测试，不必放在 DSH profile 里。 ## 已知边界 - **PTC / 单一 `run_code` 模式**：工具面被收拢成一个 `run_code` 之后，写文件不再是独立的 `write` / `edit` 调用， 而是脚本里的 `tools.write({ file_path: "..." })` / `tools.edit({ file_path: "..." })`。本插件会解析脚本提取这些字面量路径 （变量路径、含 `${...}` 的模板串跳过——宁可漏报也不猜）。脚本里用 `pwsh` 重定向写出的文件仍然只能靠官方快照补漏。 - 外部命令产生的文件（`> out.txt`、`git checkout` 等）不在登记簿里，只能靠官方 `workspaceChanges` 的 git 快照补漏；**非 git 目录下这类改动不会出现**。 - `ops_replace` 的 `glob` 参数是**模式**不是路径（`src/*.ts`、`**/*.js`），不会被展开成具体文件；那一轮登记的是它的 `path` 参数，glob 命中的文件靠官方快照补漏。 - 单轮文件数上限 `maxFilesPerTurn`（默认 200），防止病态轮次撑爆登记簿。 - **Linux 上双击是「打开」不是「定位选中」**：`xdg-open` 没有选中参数，双击会用默认程序打开该文件（目录则打开目录）。Windows / macOS 才是资源管理器 / Finder 里定位选中。 - 双击是浏览器手势，纯键盘用户可按 Enter（行有 `tabIndex`）触发定位。 ## License MIT --- ## 打赏 本项目为个人爱好驱动的开源插件，如果帮助到了您，欢迎各位大老板顺手请我喝杯咖啡，非常感谢打赏！
微信
 支付宝

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: multiple working directories per workspace, like Claude's additional directories / /add-dir
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-folders > A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives a workspace **multiple working directories**, like Claude's additional directories: add other folders to a workspace from a composer button or `/add-dir`, and the model can read them and (for read-write folders) edit them with pre-approved sandbox escalation. Works with DSH NEXT, DSH Desktop and `dsh web` on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5`. 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）工作区添加**多个工作目录**的插件，效果类似 Claude 的 additional directories / `/add-dir`：除了工作区本身的目录，还可以把其他目录（例如共享库、文档仓库、另一个前端项目）加入同一个工作区，让模型一起读写。 适配 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5`（DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next、DSH Desktop Beta）。不修改上游代码，只通过官方扩展点组合：`systemPrompt.context`、`tools/execute`、`approval/request`、`commands`、`connection.fetch`，以及 Web 客户端的 `conversation.input.left` 槽位。 ## 截图 输入框旁的「工作目录」按钮显示额外目录数量： ![输入框旁的工作目录按钮](docs/screenshots/overview.png)

管理额外目录，切换读写 / 只读
直接输入路径，或「选择文件夹…」（桌面端为系统对话框，浏览器中为应用内浏览器）
斜杠命令 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs`： ![斜杠命令](docs/screenshots/commands.png) ## 功能 - **输入框旁的「工作目录」按钮**（📁 +N）：点开后可添加、移除目录，切换「读写 / 只读」。保存后从下一轮对话起生效，本工作区的所有会话共享。 - 添加目录有两种方式：在输入框里**直接输入**路径（绝对路径或 `~/路径`，回车或点「添加」），或点「**选择文件夹…**」用选择框挑选。 - 同一个目录不能重复添加：添加时立即检查，写法不同但指向同一目录（末尾斜杠、`/tmp` 与 `/private/tmp`、符号链接、`~/…`）也算重复，会提示「已在列表中」并高亮已有的那一行；已在工作区内、或已是全局目录的路径同样会被拒绝。 - 「选择文件夹…」按环境自动选择：在 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 窗口里打开系统文件夹对话框（Finder，与添加工作区相同）；在本机 `dsh web` 中由 Host 打开系统对话框；在局域网或远程浏览器中显示应用内文件夹浏览器（从工作区所在目录开始，可点路径跳转、显示隐藏文件夹）。 - **斜杠命令**（任何有命令入口的界面都可用）： - `/add-dir <路径> [--read-only]` — 添加目录，支持绝对路径、`~/路径`、相对当前工作目录的路径；目录已在列表中时报错（要改读写权限请先 `/remove-dir`） - `/remove-dir <路径>` — 移除目录 - `/dirs` — 列出当前工作区的全部目录 - **模型可见**：每次请求的运行时上下文（紧跟沙箱策略之后）会列出额外目录及其读写权限；该上下文会写入会话日志，回放时可还原。 - **写入权限**：在默认的 `workspace-write` 沙箱模式下，DSH 只允许修改工作区目录本身。对于标记为「读写」的额外目录，模型使用 `write` / `edit` 工具写入时，插件会自动批准这次沙箱提权（审批记录照常写入会话日志 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided`）。 - 「只读」目录不会自动批准，写入仍会询问你。 - 终端命令（bash）写入额外目录仍走正常的提权确认，因为插件无法可靠判断命令会写哪里。 - 会话处于「只读」模式时不会自动批准任何写入；处于「完全访问」模式时本来就不受限制。 - **全局目录**：可在配置里指定对所有工作区生效的目录。 - **读取额外目录的指令文件**（可选，默认关闭）：开启 `loadInstructions` 后，每个额外目录根部的 `AGENTS.md`（没有时用 `CLAUDE.md`）会作为第二段运行时上下文（紧跟目录列表之后）发给模型，类似 Claude Code 的 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD`。 ## 安装 ### DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 在应用中打开 **DSH 终端**（托盘菜单或设置顶部的终端入口），执行： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders ``` 然后完全重启应用（托盘 → **退出并重启**，或设置顶部菜单 → **重启应用**）。输入框工具栏会出现文件夹按钮。 建议固定到某个 commit，避免之后的推送悄悄改变运行的代码：`github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders#`。 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-folders`，然后重启。 ### 普通 `dsh web` ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders ``` ### 从本地源码安装（开发用） ```bash git clone https://github.com/Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders.git cd dsh-workspace-folders && npm install && npm run build dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD" ``` 仓库中已包含构建好的 `lib/`，因此从 GitHub 安装不需要运行构建脚本，也不需要在 profile 中授权 `allowBuilds`。 ## 配置 默认配置见 [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)。要修改，在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`（例如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖这一行，注意要写全保留的键： ```yaml - id: workspace-folders config: autoApproveWrites: true # 设为 false 则读写目录的每次写入都需要确认 globalDirectories: # 对所有工作区生效，~ 会展开为主目录 - { path: ~/notes, access: read-only } # storeFile: /absolute/path.json # 默认 $DSH_HOME/workspace-folders.json loadInstructions: false # 设为 true 则把各额外目录根部的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 发给模型 maxInstructionBytes: 32768 # 指令上下文整体（含说明与标题）的 UTF-8 字节上限 ``` 配置写错（未知键、非绝对路径、非法 access、`maxInstructionBytes` 不是整数或小于截断标记的长度）会在加载时直接报错，而不是被静默忽略。 ### 额外目录的指令文件（`loadInstructions`） - 只看每个额外目录**根部**：优先 `AGENTS.md`；没有可用的 `AGENTS.md` 时才读 `CLAUDE.md`，两者不会同时读取。空白的 `AGENTS.md` 也算「有」，此时不再读 `CLAUDE.md`。 - 读写目录和只读目录都会读取；目录当前不存在、或没有指令文件时直接跳过，不报错。 - 指向目录外部的符号链接（文件本身或其所在路径）一律视为不存在，不会读取；指向目录内部的链接正常读取。非普通文件（目录、FIFO 等）也会跳过。 - 每次组装请求时同步重新读取，所以修改指令文件后从下一次请求起生效；内容变化时会生成新的运行时上下文快照，并像目录列表一样写入会话日志。 - 整段上下文（开头说明、每个目录的标题、正文）合计不超过 `maxInstructionBytes` 字节；超出时在 UTF-8 字符边界处截断，并以 `[Additional-directory instructions truncated here to fit the configured size limit.]` 结尾，后面的目录不再出现。 - 该上下文和目录列表一样是必需上下文（`required`），即使 profile 关闭了可选运行时上下文（`systemPrompt` 的 `includeRuntimeContext: false`）也会保留。 ## 数据存储 目录列表按工作区路径保存在 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-folders.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/workspace-folders.json`）： ```json { "version": 1, "workspaces": { "/path/to/project": { "directories": [ { "path": "/path/to/shared-lib", "access": "read-write" }, { "path": "/path/to/docs", "access": "read-only" } ] } } } ``` 文件可以手动编辑（改完需重启）。如果文件损坏，插件会拒绝加载并在日志中指出文件路径，而不会用空列表覆盖它。 ## 限制 - 额外目录按**工作区**生效（以会话创建时的工作区目录为准），不是单个会话。 - `@` 文件引用补全、技能发现仍只看工作区目录本身；需要时请让模型用绝对路径访问额外目录。 - DSH 自带的 AGENTS.md 读取只看工作区目录。额外目录的指令文件需开启 `loadInstructions`，且只读取额外目录根部的一个文件：子目录中的 `AGENTS.md`、以及 `AGENTS.local.md` / `CLAUDE.local.md` 本地覆盖文件都不会读取；内容放在运行时上下文中，不会像工作区指令那样按目录逐级合并。 - 如果某个额外目录恰好是工作区的上级目录（例如项目根），DSH 自身可能已经读取了它的 `AGENTS.md`，开启 `loadInstructions` 后同一内容会出现两次。 - 只有 `write` / `edit` 工具的写入会被自动批准；终端命令写入需要确认。 - 没有挂载任何目录选择器的组合里不会显示「选择文件夹…」，此时直接输入路径即可。 - 在还没有发送过消息的新会话里执行 `/dirs` 等命令，结果不会显示在空白首页上（命令已执行并记录在会话日志中）；用输入框旁的按钮查看更直观。 ## 开发 ```bash npm run typecheck # TypeScript 检查 npm test # 单元测试（vitest） npm run build # 生成 lib/index.js（Host）与 lib/client.js（Web 客户端） npm run check # 以上三项 ``` `lib/` 会被提交到仓库（供 `github:` 安装直接使用），修改源码后请运行 `npm run check` 并一起提交 `lib/`。 端到端冒烟测试：用真实的 `dsh --profile headless` 和 DSH 自带的 LLM mock（无需 API key），在临时 `DSH_HOME` 中验证上下文注入、`loadInstructions: true` 时首个模型请求带上额外目录的指令（且默认不带）、读写目录的自动批准、只读目录不批准、以及不装插件时写入被拒绝： ```bash node scripts/smoke-headless.mts /@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js /packages/test-support/llm-mock-server/src/index.ts ``` 需要 Node ≥ 22.19 和 `zstd` 命令行工具。 ### 结构 | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `src/index.ts` | 插件入口：挂载上下文、自动批准、命令、路由（所有 Host 服务均为可选） | | `src/folders.ts` | 生效目录计算、校验、写入授权判断、模型上下文文本 | | `src/instructions.ts` | 读取额外目录根部的 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`，生成有字节上限的指令上下文 | | `src/approval.ts` | 跟踪提权的 `write`/`edit` 调用，应答匹配的审批请求 | | `src/commands.ts` | `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` | | `src/routes.ts` | `/api/workspace-folders/{state,save,pick,browse,resolve}` | | `src/store.ts` | JSON 存储（原子写入、按顺序串行） | | `src/client/index.tsx` | 输入框按钮与对话框 | ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, what it shadows, and whether the copies agree.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-which

**Command resolution forensics for DeepSeek Harness.** When you type `node`, a shell answers with a rule that is longer than people remember — PATH order, then PATHEXT on Windows or the executable bit elsewhere, with builtins short-circuiting the whole thing. `dsh-which` reports what that rule actually decided, what it shadowed, what shape PATH itself is in, and whether the copies behind one name agree on a version.

Every failure it names is silent. The command runs; it is just not the one you meant.

```
dsh-which · node
  winner:   C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
  kind:     native binary
  from:     PATH[0]  C:\Program Files\nodejs
  size:     84MB
  modified: 2025-11-03T09:14:00.000Z
  version:  v24.13.0  (--version)
  searched: 9 PATH entries

  shadowed — 1 other directory holds this name:
    PATH[6]  C:\Users\me\scoop\shims\node.EXE  native binary  84MB
      ↳ reports v20.11.1

  ⚠ the copies behind this name report different versions — the one that runs is the one at PATH[0].
```

That last block is the whole reason this exists. Two Node installations, one on PATH, and nothing anywhere tells you which one a command gets.

## Why not just run `which`

1. **`which` does not exist on Windows**, and where it does exist it answers a narrower question. It reports the file it found; it does not report the file it skipped.
2. **`which` inherits the rules under investigation.** Shelling out to a resolver to explain resolution means trusting the resolver you are debugging. The rules here are reimplemented as pure functions over an injected filesystem (`lib/resolve.js`), so they are testable against fixtures instead of against whatever is installed on the test machine.
3. **Shell builtins are not files.** `which cd` on most systems walks every PATH entry to report something that has nothing to do with what runs. This plugin says `builtin` and explains that PATH was never consulted.
4. **The interesting output is the shadowed copy.** "What runs" is one line. "What else answers to this name, and why is it not running" is the diagnosis — a stale global install behind a fresh local one, a `.cmd` shim in front of a real binary, a file that exists but was never made executable.
5. **Reporting is the whole job.** There is no PATH-editing tool here. A plugin that silently rewrites PATH is a plugin that breaks a machine.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-which
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```sh
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-which
```

Optional configuration, in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: which
  name: 'dsh-which'
  config:
    probeByDefault: false        # run a version probe on every resolve
    probeShadowedByDefault: false # probe the shadowed copies too
    probeTimeoutMs: 4000
    maxSweepFiles: 400
    runtimes: [node, npm, pnpm, python, git]
```

| key | default | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `4000` | How long a version probe may take before it is abandoned. |
| `probeByDefault` | `false` | Probe every resolve without being asked. Slower, explains more. |
| `probeShadowedByDefault` | `false` | Probe the shadowed copies too. Multiplies the process spawns. |
| `maxSweepFiles` | `400` | Files examined in one sweep, so a huge directory cannot stall a session. |
| `runtimes` | node, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, python, python3, pip, pip3, uv, git, rg, fd, make, pwsh, bash | Commands the environment report resolves. |

Probing is off by default because it spawns processes, and a diagnostic that costs four seconds on every call is a diagnostic people turn off.

## Tools

### `which_resolve`

Resolve one command and report what runs, what it shadowed, and — on request — what each copy reports as its version.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string, **required** | A name (`node`) or a path (`./build.sh`, `C:\tools\x.exe`). |
| `probe` | boolean | Run the winner with a version flag. |
| `probeShadowed` | boolean | Probe the shadowed copies too, so versions can be compared. |

A name that resolves to nothing is an answer, not an error:

```
dsh-which · build
  not found
  the name exists on PATH but nothing with that name is runnable
  searched: 45 PATH entries

  the name exists, but nothing with it can run:
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        … and 37 more
```

The count is the finding; the enumeration is the evidence, and past eight directories the evidence stops being read. The lines that save an hour are the second and third: the name *is* on PATH, the file simply cannot run. On POSIX that means no executable bit — a shell walks right past it into later PATH entries, or fails.

An explicit path never consults PATH, and the report says so:

```
dsh-which · /repo/scripts/build.sh
  winner:   /repo/scripts/build.sh
  kind:     script
  from:     given as a path, PATH was not consulted
  size:     2.3KB
  searched: 0 PATH entries
```

### `which_path`

The shape of PATH itself: every entry in resolution order, with duplicates, entries whose directory is gone, and entries containing an unexpanded variable.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showNoise` | boolean | Include `/usr/bin`, `/bin` and friends, omitted by default as uninformative. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum entries listed. Defaults to 40. |

```
dsh-which · PATH
  9 entries · 8 unique directories
  1 duplicate entry · 1 dead entry

  entries, in resolution order:
    [ 0] C:\Program Files\nodejs
    [ 1] C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm
    [ 2] C:\Windows\system32
    [ 3] C:\Windows
    [ 4] C:\tools\git\cmd
    [ 5] C:\Program Files\nodejs  — dup of [0]
    [ 6] C:\Users\me\scoop\shims
    [ 7] D:\old-python\Scripts  — missing
    [ 8] C:\Users\me\bin

  Duplicates are usually an installer that prepends itself on every run. Harmless until you edit "the" entry and two copies of it remain.

  Dead entries are skipped silently by every shell, so an uninstalled toolchain leaves a hole that only shows up when its command fails.
```

A dead entry is invisible by construction: shells skip it without a word, so the hole only surfaces later as "command not found" for something that was there yesterday. An unexpanded `%USERPROFILE%` is worse — it can never resolve, no matter what the variable is set to.

### `which_env`

One page describing the command environment: platform, shell, working directory, PATH findings, PATHEXT, and where each common runtime resolves from.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | Maximum runtimes listed. Defaults to 30. |

```
dsh-which · environment
  platform: win32  arch x64  node v24.13.0
  shell:    pwsh.exe  (C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe)
  cwd:      C:\repo
  PATH:     9 entries · 8 unique
            1 duplicate · 1 dead
  PATHEXT:  .COM .EXE .BAT .CMD

  resolved runtimes:
    · node  C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
    · npm  C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
    · pnpm  C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.CMD
    · git  C:\tools\git\cmd\git.EXE
    ✗ python  not found

  1 runtime(s) exist in more than one place on PATH: node
```

The shell line matters more than it looks. `pwsh` and `cmd` disagree about builtins and about `.ps1`, so a report that names the wrong shell is a report nobody should trust.

### `which_sweep`

Sweep a directory of scripts and report, for each name that looks like a command, whether the copy in *that* directory is the one that would run.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `directory` | string, **required** | Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum rows listed. Defaults to 60. |

```
dsh-which · sweep C:\repo\scripts
  3 command(s)
  1 resolve outside this directory (shown with ↪)
  1 do not resolve at all

  ↪ build.cmd  → C:\tools\build\build.cmd
  · deploy.cmd  C:\repo\scripts\deploy.cmd
  ✗ smoke.cmd  does not resolve

  A ↪ means a copy in this di

# dsh-tool-planner

A DSH skill that helps non-programmers plan and build a tool by interview.

It walks the user through how they do the task by hand today, one plain-language step at a time, turning each step into a flowchart node. Then a short round of automation questions, a plain-language plan, and explicit approval before building.

## Install

**Desktop app:** open **Plugins → Add Plugin**, paste the source below, click install, then restart the app.

```
github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner
```

**Terminal:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner
```

If `dsh` is not on your PATH, put `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` in place of `dsh`. Restart dsh after installing.

To pin a release, add a tag: `github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner#v0.1.0`.

## Usage

Describe what you want in 3–4 lines. Answer in plain language — no technical knowledge needed.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tool-planner
```

## Credits

Built by [Wasif Alam Dip](https://github.com/WasifAlamDip).

## License

MIT

# dsh-session-cleaner

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** plugin — host half and Web client half in one bundle — that adds two
things to the DSH Web GUI:

1. **Delete a conversation** from the sidebar session menu, with a confirmation dialog.
2. **Quote / Ask from the right-click menu** — select text in a chat message, then right-click. The
   plugin takes over the context menu and shows **Copy / Quote / Ask**, with Copy first, exactly where
   the native menu item used to be:
   - **Copy** writes the selection to the clipboard (the same action as before, now drawn by us).
   - **Quote** inserts a Markdown quote block (role + turn metadata) into the composer.
   - **Ask** sends the selection plus your question to a *concurrent subagent* and streams the answer
     into the right sidebar, without interrupting the main conversation.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

---

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | **Delete session** — stops a running session (flush + detach), detaches it from the workspace registry, invalidates its projection cache, physically removes the session directory, cleans its spill directory, cascades to its `origin: subagent` children (fork branches are never cascaded), then broadcasts `api-session/removed`. |
| `shell.overlay` | Selection **right-click menu**: **Copy** (clipboard) / **Quote** (insert into the composer) / **Ask** (concurrent subagent question). The menu is drawn by the plugin because the desktop app builds its native context menu in the Electron main process, which a renderer plugin cannot extend; `preventDefault()` on `contextmenu` keeps the native menu from popping. |
| `sidebar.right.pane.tab` | **Follow-up** tab: streams the ask subagent's answer (reasoning + text) in the right sidebar. |

### Ask reuses one subagent

Every question does **not** spawn a new subagent. The plugin keeps a single continuable subagent
labelled `ask` per parent session and delivers the next question to it (discovering the existing one
through the official `subagents.listChildren()` catalog, so it survives a host restart).

### Scoped auto-compaction for the ask subagent

Because the reused `ask` subagent's context grows with every question, the host registers its own
`agent/pre-step` listener that calls `ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded(agent, "pressure", signal)`
**only for this plugin's own ask subagents**. Global automatic compaction stays off
(`compaction-basic` is mounted with `auto: false`) — the main conversation is unaffected.

---

## Install

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle. Add it to your profile's `package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@local/dsh-session-cleaner-host": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-cleaner-host"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // …
        "@local/dsh-session-cleaner-host"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

The package name must be used consistently in three places:

- `package.json` → `name`
- `client.js` → `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "…" })`
- the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` entry

Then add the compaction backend to your profile patch layer
(`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`), which is applied **after** every bundle layer:

```yaml
# Compaction backend for the ask subagent's scoped auto-compaction.
# `auto: false` keeps GLOBAL automatic compaction off; the plugin calls
# ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded() itself, scoped to its own ask subagents.
- id: compaction-basic
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic"
  disabled: false
  config:
    auto: false
```

> Keep this row in the **profile** patch, not in this package's bundle patch: installing a plugin
> must not silently enable another package for the whole profile.

Restart DSH after changing host-side code, then reload the page. Verify which build is live:

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-session-cleaner/version
# {"ok":true,"name":"dsh-session-cleaner","build":"…","features":{…}}
```

---

## Usage

**Quote / Ask**

1. Select some text in a chat message.
2. Right-click inside the selection.
3. The context menu opens with **Copy / Quote / Ask** (Copy first, then a separator).
4. *Quote* appends a quoted block to the composer. *Ask* swaps the menu for a question box; send it
   and the **Follow-up** tab opens in the right sidebar with the streamed answer.

Right-clicking in the composer, or right-clicking without a selection, keeps the normal system menu
(cut / paste / select all).

**Delete a conversation**

Sidebar session row → `⋯` → **Delete session**. Deleting the currently open session stops it and
switches the page to a new session.

---

## HTTP API

All routes are served by the plugin's host half (same-origin, browser cookie auth):

| Method | Path | Body | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/version` | — | Which build is live (diagnostics). |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/ask` | `{ sessionId, text }` | Deliver a question to the reused `ask` subagent, creating it once if needed. |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/delete-session` | `{ sessionId }` | Delete a whole session (and cascade to its subagent children). |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/delete-subagent` | `{ childId, parentId }` | Delete one direct subagent child. Guarded by a lineage check. |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/terminate-children` | `{ sessionId }` | Drain every continuable descendant of a session. |

---

## Design notes and hard-won constraints

These are the constraints that shape the implementation. Several of them were established by reading
the shipped DSH sources, and getting any of them wrong produces silent data loss.

1. **DSH exposes no "delete a session" API.** `sessions`, `sessionPersistence`,
   `sessionProjectionCache` and `sessionController` are all append-only; the persistence seam documents
   *"Nothing deletes session files … the seam has no deletion API."* This plugin therefore performs
   deliberate on-disk surgery — and compensates with strict identity checks.
2. **Never rewrite another session's log.** The plugin originally rewrote the parent log to drop a
   `subagent/catalog` row. Session logs are append-only and may be written concurrently by the host, so
   a read → filter → atomic-rename could truncate a conversation. `rewriteParentLog` now defaults to
   **`false`**.
3. **Session directory lookup is identity-verified.** Any candidate directory must yield a log whose
   header `id` equals the requested session id; the plugin never falls back to guessing.
4. **`subagent/catalog` is append-only.** There is no supported way to remove a row, and removing the
   child's session behind a live row produces a dangling entry. The plugin does not touch catalog rows.
5. **Subagent operations are lineage-guarded.** `delete-subagent` refuses unless
   `header.parentSession === parentId && header.origin === "subagent"`, and refuses
   `childId === parentId` — without that check, "delete the subagent" can delete the conversation you
   are looking at.
6. **Compaction needs a *live idle* agent.** `compaction.compactNow(agent, signal)` takes a
   `ManualCompactAgentContext` (it needs `runMaintenance()`), but a continuable subagent is **not
   resident after its turn settles**. There is therefore no supported way to compact a *finished*
   subagent on demand; compaction only works at `agent/pre-step`, while the turn is open and the agent
   is alive. That is why the plugin hooks `agent/pre-step` instead of offering a button.
7. **Self-contained by design.** The host half imports **only Node builtins** — no `@deepseek-ai/*`
   runtime dependency, so the plugin cannot shadow the official packages in a profile's
   `node_modules`. `package.json` declares no dependencies at all.
8. **Selections are quoted verbatim** and capped at 2000 characters; a selection spanning two messages
   or inside a streaming message is ignored.

---

## Tests

```powershell
npm test
```

Two self-contained suites, no DSH, no browser and no real session data:

| Suite | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `test/internals.test.mjs` | host half: zstd session-log framing, projection keys, log decode/encode |
| `tes

plugins.description: Safe file editing for AI agents: back up, validate, roll back on failure. Zero-dependency MCP server.
plugins.readme_text:
# ai-safe-edit

**The only safe entry point for an AI agent to edit files.**
Back up, validate, roll back on failure — and never leave a half-broken file behind.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · MIT · Python 3.8+ · zero dependencies

---

## The problem

When an agent edits a file, it writes text. When that text is assembled from
shell heredocs, regex substitutions, or model-generated code, three things go
wrong often enough to actually hurt:

| Failure | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Shell escaping eats characters** | A literal `\n` inside a heredoc becomes a real newline and silently breaks the string it was part of |
| **Regex over-matches** | A pattern meant for one line crosses a string boundary and corrupts neighbouring code |
| **Nested quotes** | Putting `"` inside `"` when generating source is a syntax error — and a model produces it *often* |

The usual response is to write the lesson down. **That is not a constraint.**
The next session, or the next model, repeats the mistake.

> Real numbers from the project this came out of: **10 nested-quote errors in a
> single day**, all of them landing in the actual product files, because the
> edits bypassed the tool that existed to prevent exactly that.

> And a small confession, because it is the clearest illustration there is:
> **while writing the commit message for *this repository*, the same class of
> failure hit again.** The message contained `` `--selftest` `` inside a
> double-quoted shell string. The shell executed the backticks and deleted the
> word. The commit went in with a sentence missing its subject — and would have
> shipped that way, because nothing checks commit messages.
>
> Knowing about a failure mode is not protection from it. Only a gate is.


## What this does

It turns the lesson into a **gate**:

1. **Back up** before touching anything → `.safe_edit_backup/<timestamp>/`
2. **Validate** immediately after writing:
   `.py` → `compile()` · `.json` → `json.loads` · `.yaml` → `yaml.safe_load` · `.bat` → ASCII-only check
3. **Roll back automatically** if validation fails, and say so
4. **Non-zero exit code** on failure — a model or a script cannot miss it

A half-broken file is never left behind.

## Quick start

```bash
# edit with the safety net
python safe_edit.py --file app.py --replace "old text" "new text"

# same replacement across several files
python safe_edit.py --files a.py b.py --replace "old" "new"

# large blocks with quotes or non-ASCII text: read both sides from files
# (this is the mode to use when shell argument escaping is unreliable)
python safe_edit.py --file app.py --replace-with-file old.txt new.txt

# validate without writing
python safe_edit.py --check-only a.py b.py

# roll back to the most recent backup
python safe_edit.py --rollback app.py

# self-test: positive and negative controls
python safe_edit.py --selftest
```

On failure you get an unambiguous report and a clean file:

```
x  app.py   改 1 处后**校验失败** ⇒ **已自动回滚**：语法错 line 207: invalid syntax
            （备份 .safe_edit_backup/20261015-213510/app.py）
==> 1 个失败（已回滚）—— 调用方必须知道这次没改成     (exit code 1)
```

## Use it from an AI agent (MCP)

`mcp_server.py` exposes it over MCP — stdio, JSON-RPC 2.0, **no dependencies to
install**. Tools: `safe_edit`, `edit_check`, `edit_rollback`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ai-safe-edit": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/ai-safe-edit/mcp_server.py"]
    }
  }
}
```

Works with any MCP client — including **DeepSeek Harness**, Claude Code, Cursor
and others.

## Why an agent should be forced through this

An agent that can write files freely will, eventually, write a broken one. The
question is whether that failure surfaces **immediately, with a rollback**, or
**later, as a mysterious error in a file nobody remembers touching**.

This project's answer, learned the hard way:

- **A lesson written down is not a constraint.** A lesson turned into a gate is.
- **The caller must be told when it failed.** Silent success is worse than loud
  failure — an agent that thinks its edit landed will build on top of it.

## Honest limits

- It **cannot** judge whether an edit is *correct* — only that the result still
  parses. Semantic correctness still needs tests, gates, and a human.
- It does **not prevent** a bypass. If you want bypasses to at least leave a
  trace, see the companion idea below.
- `.py` / `.json` / `.yaml` / `.bat` are the validated formats today. Other
  extensions are backed up and written, but not checked.

## Related work

This tool was built independently inside a hardware-design agent project. After
it was working, we read **DeepSeek Harness**'s source and found it solves the
same class of problem from the other end: *hardening an experiment requires
explicit user approval* (`install_bundle` + `pendingBuilds`), so nothing the
model writes reaches persistent configuration without a human.

The two are complementary:

| | DeepSeek Harness | ai-safe-edit |
|---|---|---|
| Approach | **Prevent** — a change needs approval before it persists | **Contain** — a change is validated and rolled back if it breaks |
| Strength | Nothing unauthorized gets written | Nothing broken survives, even unauthorized edits |

A companion idea in the same spirit: after every successful edit, record a hash
of the file. A checker can then compare the current hash against the last record
and flag **"this file was changed without going through the tool"** — turning a
silent bypass into a visible one.

## License

MIT

# dsh-evidence-router

**证据构建台账 + 充分性双判仪器。** 它让「证据是否充分」这句话变得可复算。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-evidence-router": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-evidence-router" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-evidence-router name: dsh-evidence-router ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`ev_open {task, slots}` → 应返回 sessionId + **口径指纹**（开题即冻结） ## 它解决什么 在证据构建类任务里（先查、再算、再补，直到够了下结论），决定「够了」的那句话通常是**产生者自己说的**。 RECAST 让 RouterLM 自己发 `ACCEPT_CONTEXT`；REVEAL 用模型生成的 rubric；TASR 用模型的 logit margin。 三者都报告了结论，但都没有报告：**换一个判据，这些结论会不会变。** 本插件把「够了」拆成两个**可分别复算**的读数，同时落盘： | 读数 | 谁给 | 口径 | |---|---|---| | `kappa_self` | 调用方（证据的产生者） | 自报，本插件不代填 | | `kappa_cov` | 本插件 | 零模型、纯确定性：任务声明的必需槽位在证据语料上是否被字面命中 | 两者的关系分四类，其中 `premature_stop`（自判够了、覆盖说没够）是本工作预测的分歧方向。 ## 五个工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |---|---| | `ev_open` | 开一次证据会话：声明任务 + 必需槽位；返回**口径指纹**（冻结） | | `ev_observe` | 登记一次证据操作及其返回（操作你做，这里只记账）；返回覆盖增量与缺口 | | `ev_assess` | 双判：你给自判，插件给覆盖判定，返回两者关系与缺口明细 | | `ev_close` | 收口，落一行完整读数 | | `ev_report` | 读数汇总（分歧率 / 平均轮数 / 平均证据字符 / 口径指纹数） | **本插件不执行任何证据操作**——它只记账、判定、留痕。因此它可以挂在任何 harness 上，不与任何检索器或执行器耦合。 ## 快速上手 ``` ev_open { task: "2022 年哪三个月营业利润率增幅最大", slots: [ {id:"fy", all:["2022"]}, {id:"rev", all:["revenue"]}, {id:"opinc", all:["operating_income"]} ] } → 会话 ev-...，口径指纹 a1b2c3... ev_observe { sessionId, op:"relational", result:"" } → 本轮新覆盖: fy, rev；仍缺: opinc ev_assess { sessionId, selfSufficient:true, selfReason:"我认为够了" } → ⚠ premature_stop：你判够了，独立覆盖判没够 缺口明细: opinc（missing_all）缺: operating_income ev_close { sessionId, outcome:"..." } ``` ## 两条不变量（违反即缺陷） - **I1 空语料不得报 covered**——证据为空时一律 missing 且 `reason=empty_corpus`。 报「干净」的同时必须说得清「我测到了什么」。 - **I2 无判据的槽位 fail-loud**——既无 `all` 也无 `any` 的槽位不默认 covered（`undefined_criteria`）； 槽位总数为 0 时 `covSufficient` 恒为 false。**「没有判据」不等于「已覆盖」。** ## 口径诚实声明 `kappa_cov` 是**字面量级**的弱仪器（大小写不敏感子串命中），不理解语义、不做推理。 它的价值**不在准确，而在独立**：它不与证据的产生者同源，因此两者的分歧本身就是一个可观测事实。 若用弱仪器都能测出显著分歧，那说明充分性判定对判据的选择高度敏感——这是**下界**，不是上界。 完整契约、边界与未决问题见 [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md)。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-evidence-router && npm test ``` **13 条用例**（跑一次得到）。

# dsh-preset-ops

预设工程流程助手——把「色欲之罪预设」的创作与迭代流程（技能 `tavern-preset-iteration` 里的五态状态机）做成工具，让流程不靠记忆。 **它不写预设内容**：内容只从 `source.md` 进、产物只从 `build.py` 出。插件只搬动事实与判据。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-preset-ops": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-preset-ops" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-preset-ops name: dsh-preset-ops ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`preset_status` → 应报产物/基准/运行版三处 md5 是否一致 ## 五个工具 | 工具 | 对应流程态 | 干什么 | |---|---|---| | `preset_status` | 任何改动前后 | 只读体检：三处 md5 是否一致、启用态双写是否自洽、块数/字符、git 干净度与最新 tag | | `preset_gate` | S4 验证 | 按序跑 `build.py → verify.py → assemble.py`，**以退出码裁决**，失败报「断在哪一步 + 哪类失败」 | | `preset_diff` | S4-4 | 逐字段比对两版 json，打印「有改动的块」清单（重构安全带） | | `preset_metrics` | S1 / S4-5 | 位格统计 / 思考链注意力预算 / 酒馆实测取证（含基准现算与词表指纹） | | `preset_release` | S5 发布 | 三处同步 + commit + tag。**默认干跑**；`verify.py` 未过一律拒绝。不 push | ## 配置（profile patch 行） ```yaml - insert: - id: agent-preset-ops name: dsh-preset-ops config: presetDir: E:/alice/tavern/色欲之罪预设 workspaceRoot: E:/alice/tavern pythonExe: python timeoutMs: 180000 ``` `baselineJson` 留空时自动扫描工作区根目录里版本号最高的 `色欲之罪V*.json`（数值比较，`V3.10 > V3.3`）。 ## 边界（不做什么） - 不写 `source.md` / `skeleton.json`；不直接改产物 json（产物只能由 build 生成） - **不 push**：本项目只做本地仓库（红线：不开源） - 不替主人裁决改什么——工具只报事实与判据 - 释放动作默认干跑，`verify` 是硬前置门 ## 开发与验收 ```powershell # 类型只需两个纯 devDeps（.npmrc 已禁 auto-install-peers，防 @deepseek-ai 真实副本遮蔽宿主 link farm） node /node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json # 判据：退出码 0 node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" # 15 项离线单测 ``` `src/runner.ts` 是纯逻辑层（路径/命令/解析/失败归类，无 I/O），`src/index.ts` 只接线。 判据纪律：**通过与否以退出码为准**，文本解析只服务展示；失败分「跑不动」（解释器缺失/超时/脚本不存在）与「跑了没过」两类，前者即停不掩盖。 详细契约与可证伪验收表见 `docs/semantic.md`。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-preset-ops && npm test ``` **18 条用例**（跑一次得到）。 ## 落盘与自证 **本插件无持久产物**——它不写文件、不落侧车；判据全在**行为侧**（见「快速开始」的 30 秒验证与「生效判据与回退」节）。

plugins.description: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-crop-zoom

**Magnify a region of an image so small text becomes readable.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (`dsh`) plugin that registers a
`crop_zoom` tool, plus the same engine as a standalone CLI.
[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)

- Local image processing only — no network, no model call, no OCR engine.
- One dependency: `sharp` (libvips), loaded lazily so a missing native build can never stop the harness from booting.
- Node ≥ 22. MIT.

---

## The problem this solves

A 1920×1080 screenshot does not reach a model at 1920×1080. It is downscaled on the way
in, so a 10–11px item label arrives with its strokes already fused — and re-reading the
same screenshot cannot bring those pixels back.

Four readings off one status screen, every one of them wrong in the same way:

| Printed | Came back as | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `03重型盔` | `D3重型盔` | at 11px the `0` and the `D` share one left stem |
| `BT6重型` | `B16重型` | the `T` welds itself onto the `B` before it |
| `1000戰地包` | `100D戰地包` | four digits merge into three plus a letter |
| `鎏影權鋒` | `盜影權杖` | the 金 under 鎏 collapses into something 皿-shaped |

Those characters are perfectly legible once the region is cropped out and upscaled.
Doing that *before* the text is read is the only reliable order of operations, and it
costs far less than pushing the whole screenshot through again.

## Install as a dsh plugin

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-crop-zoom     # from a registry
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-crop-zoom   # from a local checkout
```

Then restart the app. The model gains a `crop_zoom` tool, re-sent with every request.

## Install as a CLI

```bash
npm install -g dsh-crop-zoom
crop-zoom -i shot.png -r 1178,588,64,24 -s 16 -o label.png
```

## Using the tool

```jsonc
// One region, auto-magnified until its long edge reaches 1600px
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png", "regions": [{ "x": 1178, "y": 588, "width": 64, "height": 24 }] }

// Two regions, stacked into a single labelled sheet so one follow-up read covers both
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png",
  "regions": [{ "x": 80, "y": 430, "width": 540, "height": 300, "label": "rank board" },
              { "x": 875, "y": 155, "width": 450, "height": 660, "label": "gear" }],
  "target": 2400 }

// Still ambiguous? nearest replicates pixels, which separates equal-width glyphs
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png", "regions": [{ "x": 1444, "y": 373, "width": 96, "height": 42 }],
  "scale": 16, "mode": "nearest" }
```

The tool writes PNG file(s) and returns their paths; read the result with `read_image`.
The text it returns is geometry only — deliberately, so it cannot be mistaken for the
answer:

```
1 file written from C:\shots\raid.png (1920x1080), kernel bicubic.

#1  source 1178,588 64x24  x12  -> 768x288
#2  source 1444,373 96x42  x12  -> 1152x504

Sheet (regions stacked top to bottom, in the order above): C:\...\raid-20261014181815.png

Now read that file with read_image. Do not answer from this geometry summary alone.
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | — | Absolute path to the source image. Required. |
| `regions` | array | — | 1–8 regions, in sheet order. Required. Each is `{x, y, width, height, label?}` in **source** pixels. |
| `scale` | integer | — | Integer magnification, 1–16. Omit to derive it from `target`. |
| `target` | integer | `1600` | With no `scale`, magnify until the region's longer edge reaches this many pixels, capped at 16×. |
| `mode` | enum | `bicubic` | `bicubic` \| `nearest` \| `lanczos` \| `mitchell`. |
| `sheet` | boolean | `true` | Stack every region into one labelled PNG. `false` writes one file per region. |
| `outPath` | string | temp dir | Where to write; must end in `.png`. |
| `previewWidth` | integer | — | Set this when the coordinates were measured on a downscaled preview: pass that preview's pixel width and every coordinate is rescaled to the source automatically. |

`bicubic` preserves glyph outlines and is the right default. `nearest` replicates whole
pixels, which is what separates a `0` from a `D` — the two are complements, so when a
character still will not resolve, look at it both ways.

### CLI

```
crop-zoom -i <image> -r <x,y,w,h> [-r <x,y,w,h> ...] [options]

  -i, --image <path>        Source image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF or GIF)
  -r, --region <x,y,w,h>    Region to magnify; repeat up to 8 times
  -s, --scale <n>           Integer magnification, 1..16
  -t, --target <px>         Auto-magnification target (default 1600)
  -m, --mode <kernel>       bicubic (default) | nearest | lanczos | mitchell
  -o, --out <file.png>      Output path, or path stem when writing one per region
      --preview-width <px>  Coordinates came from a preview of this pixel width
      --no-sheet            One file per region instead of one stacked sheet
      --json                Also print the raw result object
  -h, --help                Show this message
```

## How it works

1. Decode the source once into memory. Regions are bounded against the *display* size
   (after EXIF rotation), so an upright photo is cropped where it looks upright.
2. `extract` each region, then `resize` by an integer factor with the selected kernel —
   integer scaling avoids resampling artefacts on exactly the strokes you are trying to read.
3. Optionally composite the pieces into one sheet, captioned with the geometry of each
   region, so a multi-region check costs one follow-up read rather than several.

## Limits

- **Local files only.** Remote URLs are not fetched; that keeps the tool from becoming an
  outbound request channel on the model's behalf.
- Output is always PNG.
- 8 regions and 16× per call.
- Sheet captions are ASCII; non-Latin caption text depends on the fonts fontconfig
  exposes to librsvg, so put non-ASCII descriptions in the region `label` rather than
  expecting them on the image.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test        # core geometry suite + plugin contract suite
```

`test/run.mjs` builds its own synthetic image and asserts exact output geometry.
`test/plugin.mjs` exercises `apply()` against a stub `ctx` and checks that a throwing
registry cannot escape.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cache-report

[![CI](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-brightgreen)

> **命中率从 96% 掉到 80%，是谁吃的？**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）提示缓存命中率与工具块成本报表。一条命令告诉你：今天的 token 花在哪、哪次操作最贵、哪个插件在占位。

> 中文 | [English](README.en.md) · MIT · 零运行时依赖

## 它回答什么问题

大模型的输入分「命中缓存」和「未命中」两种价钱（DeepSeek 官方约 **1 : 10**）。缓存按**前缀**精确匹配，而请求的排布是：

```
[工具定义]   ← 一变，后面全部作废
[系统提示]
[历史消息…]  ← 缓存主要靠这里
[本轮新内容] ← 只有这里应该按未命中计费
```

于是：**在长会话中途装一个插件、启停一个组件、切一次权限档，工具定义就变了——此后整段上下文（系统提示 + 全部历史）会按全价重算一遍。**

多数人只看到命中率掉了，却不知道是谁吃的。这个工具就是回答这个的。

## 安装

前置：DSH（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`）+ Node.js ≥ 20。

### 方式 A：作为 DSH 插件（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:youran0faust/dsh-cache-report#main
```

重启 DSH（或依赖 profile 的 `patchReload: live` 热加载），然后在会话输入框打：

```
/cache-report
```

**它只注册斜杠命令、不注册任何工具**——因此**不改变工具表、不会破坏你自己的缓存**。常驻零成本。

### 方式 B：独立脚本（不需要插件机制）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report.git
node dsh-cache-report/lib/report.mjs today
```

零运行时依赖，只用 Node 内置模块（`node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:zlib` / `node:os`）。

## 命令

| 输入 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/cache-report` | 不带参数 = `today`：今天的命中率 + 大额重算归因 |
| `/cache-report days 7` | 近 7 天趋势表 |
| `/cache-report tools 30` | 工具块成本 / 按插件拆分 / 从未被调用的死重 |
| `/cache-report before-after 24` | 近 24 小时：工具表变化时间线 + 重算代价 + 真实台账花费 |
| `/cache-report debug 7` | 格式自检：DSH 会话格式是否仍符合预期 |
| `/cache-report help` | 用法 |

独立脚本用法相同：`node lib/report.mjs days 7`。

## 示例输出

> 以下数字为**示意**，用于展示输出形状。

```
$ /cache-report days 7

# 近 7 天缓存趋势（扫描 96 个会话文件）

日期          请求    命中率      未命中tok       命中tok   大额重算   归因Top
2026-10-09     412    95.8%       1,204,331    27,461,882       12   compaction 41%
2026-10-10     688    96.1%       1,988,204    48,932,110       19   compaction 52%
2026-10-11     903    95.4%       2,741,558    56,880,231       27   compaction 47%
2026-10-12     744    94.9%       2,105,772    39,204,118       22   compaction 55%
2026-10-13     611    92.3%       3,388,901    40,612,447       38   compaction 58%
2026-10-14     402    79.5%       6,120,338    23,742,905       61   compaction 74%
2026-10-15     288    73.6%       4,884,120    13,618,442       44   toolset-change 48%
```

拐点出现在 10-14，而且**归因换了人**：从 `compaction`（历史压缩）变成 `toolset-change`（工具表变化）——那正是当天连装了几个插件的日子。

```
$ /cache-report tools

来源               工具数      tok    占比   其中从未调用
  agent-teams           14    4,508   24.9%   ~4,407 tok
  host-core             21    4,308   23.8%   ~224 tok
  dsh-mnemon            17    3,579   19.8%   ~1,315 tok
  dsh-ops                5    2,056   11.4%   ~378 tok
  dsh-undo-savepoint    15    1,936   10.7%   ~1,557 tok
  shell/job              4    1,151    6.4%   -
  modsearch              4      520    2.9%   ~190 tok

## 从未被调用（共 37 个 / ~8,071 tok）
  ~  790 tok  agent_teams_create_task          agent-teams
  ~  752 tok  agent_teams_update_task          agent-teams
  ...
```

## 怎么读：命中率是**比率陷阱**

**命中率 = 命中 / (命中 + 未命中)**。但**别只盯比率**——它会被上下文长度稀释或放大：

| | 命中率 | 每次请求 token | 实际花销 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 长会话 | 96% | 190k | 高 |
| 短会话 | 80% | 148k | **更低** |

比率掉了，账单可能反而降了。**真正该看的是「未命中 token 的绝对值」**，那才是按全价计费的部分。

工具把「单请求未命中 ≥ 5 万 token」（阈值 `DSH_REPORT_BIG` 可调）的事件称为**大额重算**，并按原因归类：

| 归因 | 含义 | 你能控制吗 |
|---|---|---|
| `toolset-change` | 装/卸插件、启停组件、切权限档 | ✅ **能** —— 攒着一起改，改完开新会话 |
| `compaction` | 历史压缩（长会话的必然代价） | ⚠️ 半能 —— 会话别拖太长 |
| `session-start` | 新会话冷启动 | ⛔ 正常开销 |
| `resume` | 恢复旧会话 | ⛔ 正常开销 |

### 三条实用规则

1. **插件攒着一起装，装完开新会话。** 中途装一个，当前会话的历史就得全价重算一遍。
2. **别在长会话里切模型 / 切权限档。** 同理，都在改前缀。
3. **看未命中 token 的绝对值，不看百分比。**

## 数据来源与隐私

读的是本机 DSH 会话日志：`$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 下的 `session.v*.jsonl.zstd`（多帧 zstd，脚本按魔数切帧逐帧解）。

只用其中的**用量数字**与**工具表**：

- `assistant/message` → `usage.inputTokens`（未命中）/ `usage.cacheReadTokens`（命中）
- `request/header` → 当时的工具定义列表 + `reason`（`initial` / `series` / `resume` / `change`）

**不会打印任何对话内容、文件内容或密钥**；`tools` 只输出工具**名字**。所有计算在本机完成，**不联网、不上传**。

## 局限（诚实说明）

- **token 数是估算**：工具表按 `ASCII字符/4 + 非ASCII字符/1.5` 估算，误差约 ±10%。
- **归因是启发式的**：按「大额重算之前最近的一个原因事件」判定，压缩与工具表变化挨得近时可能归错。
- **只覆盖能观测到的**：读的是 DSH 落盘的会话日志，未落盘或被清理的会话不计入。
- **zstd 依赖 Node ≥ 22.15**（`node:zlib` 的 zstd API）。更低的 Node 会报错。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cache-report
```

独立脚本直接删目录即可。它不写任何配置、不常驻进程、不留状态。

## 开发

```bash
node lib/report.mjs help        # 自检
node lib/report.mjs days 2      # 快速冒烟
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在插件设置卡里调会话自动压缩的触发阈值与保留比例，保存即时写进 agent preset 隔离的压缩引擎
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-threshold

在 **插件 → dsh-compaction-threshold** 的配置卡里调 DSH 的会话压缩阈值，保存后即时生效，不需要重启。

| 设置项 | 默认 | 范围 | 说明 |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| 触发阈值 | 80% | 17–90 | 自动压缩在**已路由模型上下文窗口**的百分之多少处触发 |
| 保留近期对话 | 16% | 1–89 | 压缩时逐字保留的最近对话比例，必须小于触发阈值 |
| 自动压缩 | 开 | — | 关闭后不再自动压缩，手动 `/compact` 仍可用 |

例：窗口 1,000,000 的模型，触发阈值 80% → 800,000 tokens 处压缩，逐字保留 160,000 tokens。

## 为什么不能只改 profile 配置

DSH 内核**本来就带压缩**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`，默认 `thresholdRatio = 0.8` /
`retainRatio = 0.16`），但在 web / desktop 装配下**改不到**：

- 组合里**进程级**那一行 `compaction-basic` 是被禁用的；
- 每个 **agent preset 在自己的隔离 realm 里各挂一个** `BasicCompactionEngine`
  （`presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml` 的 `compaction` 组，`isolate: { compaction: true }`）；
- 往 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 写同 id 行**不落到会话实际用的那个引擎**。

## 实现要点（内核 0.1.5-rc.2 实测）

1. **取得引擎**：`ctx.get('agentPresets').serviceFor(agent, 'compaction')`
   → 返回该会话所在 preset 隔离 realm 内的 `BasicCompactionEngine`。
2. **改值的正确姿势是「替换整个 config 对象」，不能原位赋值**：
   - `Object.isFrozen(engine.config) === true`，而 `config` 属性本身 `writable: true`；
   - 原位赋值在 ESM 严格模式下抛 `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'thresholdRatio'`，
     被 `try/catch` 吞掉就等于**静默什么都没做**（这点极易踩坑）；
   - 引擎每次决策都重新读 `this.config`，所以整体替换即热更新。实测替换后 45 秒回读仍是新值。
3. **枚举存活会话用 `ctx.get('agents').list()`**：
   `sessionPersistence.list()` 的条目形状是 `{ header, revision, sizeBytes }`，
   会话 id 在 `entry.header.id` 里、**顶层没有 id**；照顶层取会永远扫到 0 个会话。
4. **两条落地路径**：
   - 保存设置时立即扫描存活会话写入（实测 1.5 秒内引擎即为新值）；
   - 每个 step 边界 `ctx.on('agent/pre-step', …, { prepend: true })` 再兜底同步一次。

不改压缩算法、不碰会话日志：摘要生成、消息替换、checkpoint、持久化、溢出恢复
全部仍是官方 `compaction-basic` 负责。设置值持久化在设置存储（命名空间
`dsh-compaction-threshold`），进程重启后由 step 边界重新应用。

## 安装（本机 DSH Desktop）

Desktop 独占 profile 装配，`dsh plugin add` 在本机不可用。走本地热装配：

```
npm pack                                  # → dsh-compaction-threshold-0.1.0.tgz
# 解包到 D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-compaction-threshold
# dev_install_package(dir, profile='desktop')
```

本插件宿主半边只 import `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（`0.2.0` 起 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
的 `installSettingsSection` / `settingsNamespace` 已删除，导入它们会让宿主起不来）。
link 安装的插件目录没有自己的 `node_modules`，因此目录内建立一个**指回内核同一份**的
junction（不是拷贝，避免版本偏移）：

```
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/schemastery → <app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/schemastery
```

（`<app>` = 官方 Harness 安装目录，例如 `D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app`。
注意**不要**指向社区 Desktop 或其它副本：目标一旦被卸载/移动，悬空链接会让插件
`failed to import`、宿主启动报错。）

装完**硬刷新页面**（Ctrl+Shift+R），在 **插件 → dsh-compaction-threshold** 的配置卡里
即可看到本行（0.2.0 起第三方插件的配置卡在插件页，不在「设置 → 通用」）。

> ⚠️ 改本插件的代码后需要**重启 DSH Desktop** 才生效：本机 super-injector 的
> `dev_reload_package` 拿不到 `loader.internal`，只会"重新装配"旧模块；
> 且 `dev_install_package` 见到已存在的 loader entry 会跳过 create。重启后由
> profile 的 bundles 列表正常装配。

## 验证

宿主日志（`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\dsh-<日期>.log`）里会有：

```
[dsh-compaction-threshold] audit-><写入路径> {"event":"applied","thresholdRatio":0.62,…}
```

同时会往下列第一个可写目录追加一行 JSONL 审计（`dsh-compaction-threshold.jsonl`）：
`$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` → 本插件目录。

## 限制

- 只调**阈值类**策略；压缩范围选择、摘要质量、按模型覆盖（`modelPolicies`）、
  摘要模型选择不在本插件范围内。
- 只支持**百分比**；按绝对 Token 设阈值需要知道每个模型窗口，未做。
- 若别处设过 `retainTokens`，本插件会清掉它（与 `retainRatio` 互斥）。
- 某个 preset 若没有压缩组（不压缩的 preset），`serviceFor` 拿不到引擎，本插件对它无效。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: 替换输入框下方统计栏：Token、上下文、缓存、模型与工具耗时、轮次、步数，明细悬浮显示
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Session Metrics

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-session-metrics` is a community desktop plugin (not an official DeepSeek product) for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. It replaces DSH's shipped statistics band below the composer with one row showing billed tokens, context usage, cache hit, model time, the running turn's model time, tool time, turns and steps; everything else lives in a hover panel. It modifies no core code, writes no files, and starts no separate service.

## Behavior

- The Host subscribes to `session/event` and folds the durable log into per-Session counters: `turn/start` and `step/start` drive the turn and step counts, `step/start` to `assistant/message` is the model wall time for one step, and `tool/call`/`tool/result` pairs give per-tool call counts and durations.
- Every figure is a delta between log commit timestamps, not an observer's wall clock. A Session that already existed when the plugin loaded is backfilled from `session.snapshotEvents()`, and each later append is folded exactly once by `seq`; a Session disposed in the Host is dropped from memory.
- The row reads the shipped `contextPressure`, `sessionStats` and `tokenUsage` projections, so its figures match DSH's own and update live. `本轮模型` is the turn-scoped model time: the running turn's charged and in-flight model time, or the most recently closed turn's while idle. Hovering (or focusing/clicking) the row opens a panel styled like the shipped stat dialog: tool-call count and failures, the turn's model time, Session span, context use and its breakdown, the token split, and the top tools by accumulated time. Token and context figures use k/M units with each part shown as a share. It closes on Escape, an outside press, or when the pointer leaves.
- The Host route supplies only what the projections lack (tool-call count, per-tool times, failures, Session span, the turn-scoped model time). It is polled every 2.5 seconds while the page is visible, because the row itself carries the turn figure; polling pauses while the page is hidden.
- If neither the projections nor the Host have data, the row stays hidden.
- The local `/myspace-session-metrics/api` route accepts only loopback, a valid Host, same-origin Origin/Fetch Metadata, and the `X-DSH-Session-Metrics: 1` header, and only `GET` with a validated `sessionId`. Counters live in memory and are lost when the plugin unloads or DSH restarts; nothing is written to disk.
- The row registers as `id: stats` at `priority: -1` in `conversation.composer.dock`, shadowing the legacy shipped stats cell. On newer DSH, empty overrides at the same priority also shadow the split `activity` and `usage` cells, preventing duplicate statistics without hiding other plugins' dock entries. The legacy context meter beside the slot is hidden because its figure is in the row. The root keeps the shipped `data-composer-stats` hook so themes style one band with one top rule. Disabling the plugin releases all overrides and restores the shipped statistics and meter.

## Development and installation

Install the npm package `dsh-session-metrics` through the DSH plugin manager. Only the desktop profile is supported; do not install it in the Web profile.

No build is required; the native ModuleLoader Client ships in the package. For development, install `link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-metrics` and restart DSH after Host changes, because the Host module cache is not reloaded by a page refresh.

```sh
npm test
node --check src/client.js
```

Tests cover the log fold (turn/step/model/tool accounting, turn-scoped model time, unterminated tool calls, replay idempotence, formatting), the Host route boundary (Session-id validation, loopback/same-origin/header gate, tracker backfill, disposal), and the Client half (the bundle loads through the ModuleLoader seam, shadows the shipped stats cell, renders the row from the shipped projections plus the Host's turn figure, falls back to the Host reading, stays empty for an empty Session or an unreachable Host, and skips polling while the page is hidden). Runtime acceptance on a live DSH desktop session — the row and the hover panel — must be verified separately; passing unit tests is not runtime acceptance.

## Limitations

- Token counts are reported by the provider; a step without a `usage` record contributes duration but no tokens, and the cache-hit share stays `—` instead of showing a made-up percentage.
- Tool durations cover only calls that both started and ended inside the observed log; a call still open when its turn closes is counted as one failed call.
- `本轮模型` follows the whole-log model figure: a turn whose steps assemble no assistant message (cancelled mid-stream, for example) charges no model time, so between turns the item keeps the last closed turn's value.
- Counters start from the Session log the Host can see. A Session restored from storage without its events replayed contributes only its new appends.
- The Host reading is a polled read of local counters; it is not a tracing or billing source, and it does not upload anything.

## Trusted publishing

[The publishing workflow](<.github/workflows/publish.yml>) uses GitHub Actions OIDC without storing an npm token. Run it manually on `main` with the reviewed full commit SHA in `expected_sha`. `dry_run` defaults to true; set it to false only for an approved new-version publication. The workflow rejects a mismatched SHA before publishing. Committing the workflow does not configure the npm Trusted Publisher; do that in the package settings on npmjs.com.

## License

MIT; see [LICENSE](<LICENSE>).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: create spec-compliant skills from the Web UI (Huawei Cloud / generic / REST API), with a 10-point evaluation loop
plugins.readme_text:
# Scenes Skill Creator

**在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里真跑官方 creator 技能——通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能——并实时展示过程、自动评测、不达标就打回修改。**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator.svg)](https://github.com/wasteoneslife/scenes-skill-creator/blob/main/LICENSE)

包名 `@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator`（曾用名 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator`；GitHub 仓库名与 HTTP 前缀等对外契约不随包名改），是一个 DSH bundle（Host 半边 + Client 半边，全部在 Harness 进程内，没有子进程、没有监听端口）。

## 它是什么

官方 creator 技能（`common-skill-creator` / `rest-api-skill-creator` / `huawei-cloud-skill-creator`）是给命令行或会话里的 agent 用的：需求要自己写清、流程要自己盯、产物好不好要自己判断。本插件把这件事搬进 Web 界面：

1. **需求传递**：侧边栏选分类、填表单，插件把内容整理成 creator 能直接开工的请求（已经给全的值不再反问）。
2. **过程展示**：按下「开始创建」后，Host 侧新起一个**真 agent** 执行该 creator 自己的流水线，面板实时渲染阶段清单与步骤日志。
3. **评测闭环**：创建结束后真跑一遍 10 分制评测，不达标就把扣分明细交回**同一个** creator 就地修改，直到达标或用完轮数。

**插件自己不做内容创作**：SKILL.md 怎么写、references 怎么摆、脚本怎么跑，全部由该 creator 当前版本决定（插件不内嵌副本、不二次实现；上游改了，插件行为就跟着改）。

## ✨ 主要特性

- **分三类组织需求**：侧边栏为 通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能，创建记录按分类隔离，默认打开通用技能。
- **真跑，不止给提示词**：创建由 creator 技能在真 agent 里执行；步骤日志逐条记录它的工具调用、阶段切换与模型报错。
- **实时展示阶段与步骤**：阶段清单按 creator 自己的标记点亮（华为云 Phase 1–6 / 通用技能 阶段 1–5 / 标准API Step 1–4），运行中每 1 秒刷新。
- **自动评测并打回修改**：10 分制、通过线 8.5；不达标把扣分明细发回同一个 creator 修改，最多 3 轮，到顶输出评测报告。
- **无人值守也不提问**：提示词里禁止提问；creator 若仍然提问，插件按"只读、不执行变更类操作"的策略自动答复并继续（最多 5 次）。
- **保护长任务不被误杀**：看门狗按**静默**判死（默认静默 8 分钟、整段 120 分钟兜底），并识别进程被挂起（休眠）后重新计时。
- **回看历史并可靠落盘**：运行记录原子写入磁盘（临时文件 + 重命名 + 备份 + 与磁盘记录合并去重），bundle 重载或 DSH 重启后仍能重新打开，最多保留 20 条。
- **自动发现产物目录**：通用/标准API 模式没有名称与目录字段，评测阶段从 creator 写文件的路径、以及 `<cwd>/skills` 下新出现的 `SKILL.md` 自动定位产物。
- **按需拉取华为云三级目录**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库，逐级读取并缓存（默认每路径 10 分钟）；默认分类打开页面不发请求。

## 快速开始

两种安装方式。装完后**必须重启 DSH 一次**——bundle 列表与补丁层只在启动时解析（不重启的表现是侧边栏没有图标，或面板 API 404）。

**方式一 · DSH 内（任意 profile，推荐）**：在会话里让 agent 用 Harness 自带的插件管理安装这个 spec：

```text
@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator
```

**方式二 · 桌面端 profile（命令行）**：把**同一个包名**同时写进该 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`（两处都要有）：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

> **⚠️ 装完必须重启 DSH 一次**（包与配置在启动时加载）。
>
> 另外，安装用的包名必须与 `src/client.js` 里 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 的 id 完全一致（本包都是 `@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator`），不一致时浏览器侧会直接报 `bundle … loaded without registering "…"`。

最小可用配置（写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，`id` 与包内补丁一致）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-skill-creator
  name: '@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator'
  config:
    run:
      cwd: '/absolute/path/to/your/workspace'
      permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'
      passScore: 8.5
      maxEvalRounds: 3
      evalReadonlyOnly: true
      idleTimeoutMs: 480000
      phaseTimeoutMs: 7200000
      toolWaitMs: 1200000
```

`run.cwd` 是技能落盘根，产物写在 `<cwd>/skills/…`。不设时回落到 DSH host 进程的 cwd（通常是 profile 目录），技能会被写进 profile 里而不是你的工作区。上面的 `run` 键要写全，原因见「配置」一节的坑。

### 命令行安装（等价方式）

```sh
# Web / 普通 profile
dsh plugin add @cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator

# 桌面端：先完全退出客户端，再指定 desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator
```

装完**重启一次 DSH**。桌面端的 `dsh` CLI 随安装包提供（`resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`）；若手边没有该命令，也可以在插件页里直接填包名 `@cloudplugin/scenes-skill-creator` 安装。

## ⚠️ 权限要求（必读）

> **发布包默认 `run.permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'`**（写在包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不是文档假设）。
>
> 原因：creator 流程要跑 bash 脚本（`ensure_cli.sh` / `validate-skill.sh` / `test-cli-commands.sh`）与云 CLI，这些 fork 在只读或 `workspace-write` 沙箱下会被审批拦住。无人值守时没有人点「允许」，运行就静默，随后被看门狗判死——表现为**"跑一半超时退出"**（实跑数据里确有 `permission: null` 的运行以 `等待「creator」超时：已静默 8 分钟（无任何工具调用或文本）` 结束）。
>
> **风险**：创建与评测 agent 都会以完全访问权限运行（可读写文件、执行命令）。请只在**信任的工作区**使用本插件。若改成受限 preset，请确保有人在场处理审批，否则长任务大概率静默超时。

## 三种技能类型

| 显示名（侧边栏顺序） | 内部 `mode` | 委托的官方 creator | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | `generic` | `common-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/common-skill-creator` |
| 标准API管理技能 | `api` | `rest-api-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/rest-api-skill-creator` |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | `huawei` | `huawei-cloud-skill-creator` | [huaweicloud-skills](https://gitcode.com/huaweicloud/huaweicloud-skills) `master` → `skills/devtools/common/huawei-cloud-skill-creator` |

- 显示名就是侧边栏菜单文案，**数组顺序即菜单顺序（华为云固定最后）**，默认选中第一项（通用技能）。
- 每个菜单项下方还有一行**说明小字**，标明该分类对应的 creator 家族：通用技能 `common-skill-dev` · 标准API管理技能 `common-restapi-skill-dev` · 华为云基础云服务技能 `huawei-skill`。
- 内部 `mode` 键是 Host API 契约（`POST /run` 的 `spec.mode`）与记录隔离键；改显示名不动它。
- **记录按分类隔离**：创建记录卡片只列出当前分类的历史。
- **三级目录按需拉取**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库（逐级读取，默认每路径缓存 10 分钟）。
- 三个 creator 都会按需注册为可加载的 DSH skill，缓存 24 小时，可点「从仓库拉取最新」强制刷新。

各分类要填什么：

| 分类 | 表单字段 |
| --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | 一个「技能功能描述」文本框（≥8 字符）。没有名称、目录、tags 字段——这些是打包约定，由该 creator 自己推导。 |
| 标准API管理技能 | 一个「REST API 技能需求」文本框（≥8 字符），占位符是一份需求模板：技能名称 / 一句话描述 / 目标系统 / API 地址 / 认证方式 / **API 文档**。 |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | 一级目录（固定 `skills`，不可改）+ 二级目录 + 三级目录（均从仓库实时读取）+ 技能名（前缀 `huawei-cloud-` 固定，后缀 1–64 字符小写字母/数字/连字符）+「功能概括」文本框（可留空）。技能名即仓库路径第四级：`skills/<二级>/<三级>/<技能名>`。 |

**标准API模式里「API 文档」最关键**：该 creator 不猜端点——它解析你给的文档，或用 curl 实测探测；两者都拿不到就不产出。请把凭据放进环境变量，不要写在这段文本里。

## 工作流程

```text
填需求（选分类 + 填表单）
  └─ POST /dsh-skill-creator/api/run
       └─ Host：ctx.agents.create() 起一个真 agent
            agent.followup(creator 请求)           把需求交给 creator 技能
            ctx.on('agent/assistant-stream', …)    把流式帧转成阶段与步骤
       └─ 面板每 1 秒 GET /run?id=…                 渲染阶段清单 + 步骤日志

创建结束（creator 空闲）
  └─ 目标目录自动发现（通用/标准API 模式表单里没有名称，路径由 creator 决定）
       └─ 评测第 1 轮（真跑只读用例，10 分制）
            ├─ 得分 ≥ 8.5 ──────────────────────► done（附评测报告）
            └─ 得分 < 8.5 → 扣分明细 followup 回同一个 creator 就地修改（fixing）
                 └─ 评测第 2 轮 … 最多 3 轮
                      ├─ 本轮提升 < 0.2 ────────► below-threshold（早停，附报告）
                      └─ 3 轮到顶仍未达标 ──────► below-threshold（附报告）
```

运行状态：`creating` → `evaluating` →（`fixing` → `evaluating`）* → `done` / `below-threshold`；任何阶段都可能 `cancelled` / `failed`，进程重启后残留的进行中记录会标为 `interrupted`。运行中可「取消」，结束后可「← 返回」再开一次。

各 creator 的阶段清单（阶段标题就是面板上显示的文案，插件按 creator 自己的标记点亮，**只前进不回退**）：

| 分类 | 阶段 |
| --- | --- |
| 华为云 | Phase 1 · 需求分析（苏格拉底式问答） |
| 华为云 | Phase 2 · 技术调研（CLI→SDK→API 三级回退） |
| 华为云 | Phase 3 · 文档生成（SKILL.md + references + 载体） |
| 华为云 | Phase 4 · 测试准备（templates/test-vars.json） |
| 华为云 | Phase 5 · 详细测试（真实执行验证） |
| 华为云 | Phase 6 · 资源清理与合规检查 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 1 · 需求分析 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 2 · 设计 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 3 · 生成（skill 包 + 模板） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 4 · 验证（规范 + lint 检查点双通过） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 5 · eval 迭代 |
| 标准API | Step 1 · 需求澄清 |
| 标准API | Step 2 · 技术调研 |
| 标准API | Step 3 · 骨架生成 |
| 标准API | Step 4 · 自测与收尾（创建 PR/交棒属平台流水线，本面板不做） |

## 评测机制（10 分制，通过线 8.5）

创建结束后**真跑一遍评测**：由评测 agent 在被测 skill 目录里执行只读用例，再由本地评分器按平台口径打分。

| 维度 | 满分 | 明细 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 稳定性 | 4 | 功能可用 3 + 触发词充足度 1 |
| 成本 | 1 | 消耗总 token |
| 效率 | 2 | 8 项 × 0.25：完成时间 / 工具失败次数 / 重试次数 / cli / sdk / api 调用次数 / LLM 调用次数 / 上下文是否压缩 |
| 安全 | 3 | 本地规则扫描：高危 ≥1 扣 3；告警 ≥2 扣 2；告警 1 扣 1 |

- **通过线 8.5/10**（即"85 分"）；分级参考平台：`=10` 技能满分、`[8,10)` 优质技能。
- **容差 10% 且单向**：成本与效率只罚超支、不罚更省；基线为 0 视为无参照。**但从第 2 轮起才与基线比较**——首轮不再"白送"（见下条）。
- **绝对上限始终生效**（`evalTokenBudget` / `evalDurationCapSeconds` / `evalMaxToolCalls` / `evalMaxLlmCalls` / cli·sdk·api 上限 / 工具失败与重试必须为 0）：无基线时按绝对上限判定，有基线时"≤ 基线×(1+10%)"与"≤ 绝对上限"**同时**满足才满分；更省永远不罚。默认值取自实测量级（评测轮 token 23965/28550/38999/39617、时长 42.5/58.2/65.75/394.1 s、工具调用 4-8、cli 2-6、llm 4-6、工具失败 0、重试 0），正常轮次不会误伤。
- **功能可用 = 外部证据，不是评测 agent 的自编用例**：必须真实执行**被测 skill 自带夹具**里的 ≥ `minFixtureCases`（默认 3）条只读/语法用例，每条带「执行命令 + 观测结果（退出码/输出片段）+ 与期望的对比结论」，且没有 `fail`。只有自编用例、缺证据、夹具不存在或用例数不足 → 这 3 分直接 0，理由写进 `checks.functionalEvidence`；自编用例只能作为补充。
- **本地门禁（确定性，不需要 agent）**：任一不过 → 总分压到 `gateScoreCap`（默认 7.0）并确保 `verdict !== 'pass'`，同时进扣分明细、修复提示词与报告。
  1. `SKILL.md` 存在且 frontmatter 可解析（name/description 都有）；
  2. 该 kind 的测试夹具存在且可解析；
  3. `validateSkillPackage` 结构校验 error 为 0（读 `level` 字段——曾误读 `severity`，于是"恒 0 error"）；
  4. 华为云 kind：creator 自带的 `scripts/valid

plugins.description: Git worktree guard for DeepSeek Harness: session-rooted isolation, always-on git safety net, mechanical human gate
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-worktree-guard

可选的 git worktree 守卫 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件。

> **宗旨**：把 worktree 从"模型的自觉"变成"宿主的结构"——隔离靠会话根（结构），安全靠单调收窄的常开网（兜底），授权靠带 TTL 的机械人闸（治理）。

完整设计（含宿主契约证据、七条裁决性原则、决策表、Agent 沟通面）见 [doc/design.md](doc/design.md) v1.1。

## 它做什么

- **会话根模式（产品本体）**：`worktree_create` 建副本后，以副本为会话根新开会话 → DSH 沙箱自动锚定，写隔离即结构。
- **常开安全网**（是否绑定都生效）：跨副本写入、写 `.git`/状态区、push 受保护分支（master/main）、删 worktree 分支、`git -C` 定向到主根 → deny + 单轮可执行的指令。
- **读域守卫**：绑定态读主 checkout → 放行 + 溯源标记（默认 warn）或 deny（strict）——防止"写对地方、改错东西"。
- **机械人闸**：`worktree_authorize_main`/`worktree_allow` 走 pre-execute ask 门，模型无法自授。
- **收尾零债**：merge-base 证明式"已合并"判定、死绑定 prune、全树摘链接后再删副本（防 junction 穿透）。

## 守卫等级（诚实分级，P6）

| 等级 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|
| 结构拒绝 | 会话根沙箱写隔离；authorize ask 门 |
| 词法启发 | pwsh 命令文本、路径归一化判域、读域守卫（8.3 短名/变量拼接可绕——raise the bar，非边界） |
| 纯纪律 | danger-full-access 下的一切 |

已知边界详见 [doc/design.md §14](doc/design.md)。

## 安装与使用

DSH 插件（package.json `dsh.bundle.patch` → [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)）。已发布到 npm 后：

```bash
# 安装到 profile（CLI）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-worktree-guard
# 或 GUI 设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle：dsh-worktree-guard
# 验证已挂载（应看到 worktree-guard 条目）
dsh web --dump-config
```

安装后变化：未绑定会话零注入、行为不变；`worktree_*` 工具出现在会话中；git 误毁防护（push 主干/删 worktree 分支/写 `.git` 等）常开生效。

```bash
# CLI（与原生工具同一 core）
node wt.js create fix-login --brief "修复登录"
node wt.js status
```

会话内（插件加载后）使用 `worktree_create` / `worktree_enter` / `worktree_exit` / `worktree_status` 等工具；被拦截时按 deny 消息的"下一步"行动，或调用 `worktree_status`。

配置 sidecar：**主 checkout 根**的 `<repo>/.dsh/worktree-guard.json`（`protected_branches`、`read_policy`、`branch_prefix`、`main_write_whitelist`、`sync.*`、TTL 等，snake/camel 键均可；设计 §13）。注意 `main_write_whitelist` 为 **glob 全匹配**（如 `"docs/*"`、`"gen/**"`）；目录前缀不带通配符（如 `"docs/"`）不会命中。

## 开发

```bash
node --test   # 决策表单测 + 真实临时仓库集成测 + 三轮对抗审查回归（见 test/）
```

零依赖纯 ESM（Node ≥20，Windows 优先适配）。

## 谱系

opencode-worktree-isolation（透明重写、Windows 归一化）× zcode-worktree-guard（默认开放、常开网、prune、204 用例方法论）× chuck-ma opencode-worktree-guard（merge-base、block-with-instruction）→ 按 DSH 实测契约（不可改写入参）重构为结构优先形态。详见 [doc/design-review.md](doc/design-review.md)。

# dsh-intelligent-ui Interactive cards in DeepSeek Harness chats. The model writes a small interface program, the chat draws it as a native card, and every control recomputes in your browser without another model call. A button sends its text as your next message. [中文](README-zh.md) | | | |---|---| | Requires | DeepSeek Harness **>= 0.2.1-rc.1** (below 0.3.0) | | Platforms | Web UI, macOS desktop app, and Windows desktop app — one bundle, because both desktop apps load the same web client | | Verified | Web UI 0.2.1-alpha.4; macOS and Windows desktop apps 0.2.1-rc.2 | | Install | Settings → Plugins → Add plugin → `https://github.com/StarsHarryZhu/dsh-intelligent-UI` (needs `git` on `PATH`), then restart the harness and reload the page | ## How it works - The plugin registers one tool, `ui_render`, and one skill, `dsh-intelligent-ui`, which teaches the model when a card beats prose. The skill is its own part of the plugin: the Plugin Manager lists it with its own switch, and installing the plugin installs it. The model never writes HTML or JavaScript: its program is checked against the 32-component catalog and stored with the tool result. - A card draws in the tool row while the reply streams, and under the reply once it finishes. Moving a control recomputes every figure locally. - A `player` animates a card: code traced line by line, an algorithm's passes, a point moving along a curve. Playback runs in the browser and sends nothing to the model. - Cards compute integrals (including infinite bounds), derivatives, limits, sums and products, roots, and Taylor polynomials. A value that cannot be computed reliably shows "—", never a guess. - Uninstalling leaves every session opening as before; earlier calls show as ordinary tool rows. ## Development ```sh node scripts/link-dev.mjs # link the toolchain from the sibling harness checkout node build.js # type-check, build, and self-check the bundle node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run ``` `AGENTS.md` holds the rules of the tree; `docs/VERIFY.md` is the live checklist. ## The 32 components One card per component, drawn by this plugin in the host's light theme. The program behind each card is in [`docs/SAMPLES.md`](docs/SAMPLES.md). ### `card` — Layout The framed root: optional title, padding, and gap. ### `col` — Layout A vertical stack in reading order. ### `row` — Layout Equal-width cells side by side; they wrap on a narrow screen. ### `grid` — Layout An even grid of one to four columns. ### `tabs` — Layout Pages the reader switches between, by click or arrow key; only the open page is drawn. ### `tab` — Layout One page of `tabs`, labelled by its title; pages share the card's state. ### `title` — Text A headline line in five sizes. ### `text` — Text A sentence, with `{…}` live values. ### `badge` — Text A one-word status label in five tones. ### `callout` — Text One emphasized remark: an assumption, a caveat, a next step. ### `divider` — Text A hairline separator. ### `link` — Text A citation link, opened only when clicked. ### `image` — Text An inline `data:` image with alt text and a caption. ### `code` — Text Code or other preformatted text, kept exactly as written, with syntax colours in the host's palette, line numbers, a copy button, and `current=` highlighting the running line. ### `metric` — Data One prominent number that recomputes as controls move. ### `progress` — Data A proportion bar. ### `table` — Data A comparison table; `current=` highlights a row, and `sortable=true` lets the reader sort by any column. ### `keys` — Data Label and value pairs for exact figures. ### `list` — Data A bulleted list; `current=` highlights an item. ### `steps` — Data A numbered procedure; with `mono=true` and `current=`, a code listing with the running line highlighted. ### `chart` — Data A bar or line chart. ### `diagram` — Data A flowchart laid out in layers; loops return along the side, and `current=` highlights a box. ### `plot` — Math Curves of y = f(x) with a marked point, its tangent, and a shaded integral. ### `formula` — Math A typeset expression with its live value. ### `slider` — Controls A range slider bound to a number. ### `numberInput` — Controls Exact number entry. ### `textInput` — Controls A one-line text field. ### `select` — Controls A dropdown choice. ### `checkbox` — Controls An on/off switch. ### `checklist` — Controls Items to tick off with a done count; `bind=` hands the count to the rest of the card. ### `button` — Action Sends its text as your next message, then locks the card. ### `player` — Animation A control bar at the bottom of the card: plays, pauses, steps, and scrubs a number at 0.5× to 2×; everything that reads it follows. ## License [MIT License](LICENSE) © 2026 Starfield.

# dsh-invest-research

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-invest-research.svg?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-invest-research)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

> Multi-agent equity & fund research pipeline **skill plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://harness.deepseek.com).
> 同一包内提供**两个 skill**，共用脱敏门禁与环境约定：
>
> | skill | 用途 | 角色 |
> |---|---|---|
> | `stock-research` | 单只 A 股行情/估值/周期/政策分析 | 6 角色（协调员/数据员/政策员/估值周期员/风控员/审计员），双盲隔离 + 三轮审计 |
> | `fund-research` | **基金穿透式研究**（主动/指数/ETF/联接/FOF/QDII/债基）+ **可选同业对比层** | 7 角色 + 对比层 3 角色（peer-orchestrator/peer-builder/peer-red-team），五阶段 + 阶段 6 对比 |
>
> 最终都产出**每个数字带【来源|日期|口径|类型】、落盘前过 PII 脱敏**的研究报告。

**仅供研究参考,不构成投资建议。不接入任何交易通道,全程只读公开数据。**

## Install 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add github:lobster-liu/dsh-invest-research

# 或从本地目录 / zip 解包后
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add path/to/dsh-invest-research
```

> **v0.3.0 起包名由 `dsh-stock-research` 改为 `dsh-invest-research`**（加入了基金研究能力）。
> GitHub 旧地址会自动重定向；已安装旧版的用户请移除后按新名重装。
> **v0.4.0 起 `fund-research` 新增可选同业对比层**（阶段 6）：同一主题下多只基金"谁更优"，
> 由对比协调员亲自派发互相隔离的独立角色 agent 做跨基金对比 + 独立 red-team 质疑。

重启 DSH → 新会话里说 **"分析 600048"**（stock-research）或 **"分析基金 025490"**、**"穿透这只基金的持仓"**（fund-research）即触发。

## Quick check 安装自检

```bash
# 1) 个股取数冒烟(需可访问 push2.eastmoney.com;失败多为网络环境而非代码问题)
python assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_data.py --code 600000 --out /tmp/sr/data.json
# 2) 基金取数冒烟(需可访问 fund.eastmoney.com)
python assets/skills/fund-research/tools/fetch_fund.py --code 025490 --out /tmp/fr/fund.json --peer-stocks 10
# 3) 基金取数器离线自测(30 条断言,不依赖网络,期望 exit 0)
python assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_fund_tools.py
# 4) 脱敏门禁行为自检(27 场景,期望 exit 0)
python assets/skills/stock-research/tools/test_gate.py
# 5) 对比层工具离线自测(10 条断言,期望 exit 0)
python assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_peer_tools.py
# 统一入口:npm test 跑 21 条注册冒烟;npm run test:all 跑全部(21+27+30+10)
```

## What's inside

| 组成 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `assets/skills/stock-research/SKILL.md` | 个股流程总纲 + 环境解析(`EQUITY_PY` / `EQUITY_SECRET_SCANNER` / `$RUN` / `$ARCHIVE`) |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/roles/*.md` ×6 | 各角色完整提示词(含 2026-10-15 真实事故教训固化:单一数据源、口径并列、先落盘再细化) |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_data.py` | 东财双通道行情/历史取数 + 分位/最大回撤衍生计算;**空数据退出码 1** |
| `assets/skills/stock-research/tools/fetch_fundamentals.py` | **(v0.2.0)** 可选 akshare 财务基本面通道:ROE/每股净资产/负债率/现金流 + PE·PB 近一年真分位;未装 akshare 时退出码 1 不阻断主流程 |
| `install_akshare.ps1` / `requirements.txt` | **(v0.2.0)** 沙箱内离线装 akshare(Node fetch 下 wheel + `--no-index --find-links`),绕开 pip 平台临时目录 `WinError 5` 与 schannel 两个坑 |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/SKILL.md` | **(v0.3.0 / v0.4.0)** 基金流程总纲:五阶段 + 阶段6 对比层、10 章报告、5 个结论标签、三种情景、跟踪清单、条件式行动、铁律 11(对比层必由独立 agent 派发) |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/roles/*.md` ×10 | **(v0.3.0 / v0.4.0)** 协调员 + Agent1–Agent6 + 对比层 3 角色(`peer-orchestrator` / `peer-builder` / `peer-red-team`),统一提交格式 |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/fetch_fund.py` | **(v0.3.0)** 基金身份/净值/多期持仓/行业配置/债券持仓/规模份额/持有人/资产配置/经理/基准对比/重仓股快照;多通道降级,**空数据退出码 1** |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_fund_tools.py` | **(v0.3.0)** 30 条离线断言(内联 fixture + 网络桩,零网络) |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/peer_builder.py` | **(v0.4.0)** 同业筛选器:按「跟踪标的一致 + 被动属性 + 同份额类别 + 开放申购」筛同业,**只筛不评** |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/comparator.py` | **(v0.4.0)** 对比矩阵生成器:读 `peers.json` + 各基金 `report.md`/`fund.json`,对齐已冻结结论、暴露口径冲突,**不重算指标** |
| `assets/skills/fund-research/tools/test_peer_tools.py` | **(v0.4.0)** 对比层 10 条离线断言(纯逻辑 + 工作区临时目录 fixture,零网络) |
| `tools/sanitize_check.py` | 落盘前 PII 门禁:5 类泄漏规则 + 5 层公开信息白名单(财报科目/政策条款/金融术语/**基金公开披露**/否定声明);混合陷阱必拦 |
| `tools/test_gate.py` | 门禁行为自检 27 场景(真泄漏必拦/公开条款必放/基金披露必放/陷阱必拦) |
| `tools/run_pipeline.ps1` | Windows PowerShell 引导脚本(ASCII-only,PS 5.1 兼容) |

## Requirements
- DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc(skill 注册走 Host `skills` 服务;**无该服务时插件加载为 no-op,不会报错**)
- Python 3.10+(DSH 自带 runtime 直接可用;取数零第三方依赖,akshare 可选)
- 网络可达 `push2.eastmoney.com` / `push2his.eastmoney.com`(行情);政策核对建议搭配 [`dsh-web-search-pro`](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-web-search-pro)(免费 anonymous 源,本插件按 `read.fetch`-为主设计)

## 环境变量(全部可选)
| 变量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `EQUITY_PY` | 指定 Python 解释器(默认自动解析 DSH 自带 runtime) |
| `EQUITY_SECRET_SCANNER` | 外接凭据扫描器路径(如 audit-secrets.py);未设则明示 skipped,内置 PII 规则照常生效 |
| `EQUITY_WORK` | run 产物根目录(默认当前工作目录 `./equity-runs/`) |

## Privacy
- 报告**禁止出现**个人持仓/成本/资金量——落盘前 `sanitize_check.py` 强制拦截(退出码非 0 禁止写入,无绕过开关);
- 政策原文中的条款数字(如"单户上限100万元")是公开信息,白名单放行且**不改写**;
- 所有产物默认留在用户工作区,是否归档进个人笔记库(Vault/Obsidian)由用户显式配置 `$ARCHIVE`。

## License
MIT
